tilda_application.title: APPLICATION FOR CEREMONIAL IGNITION
tilda_application.//: Story Phase 17 (chapter 211): No-Nonsense Tilda's application for a ceremonial Fire-Waft ignition, on the Bureau's own 97-page form (the same proceeding engine as Lord Puffchester's). It is filed once: the permit it makes is the one she shows later (chapter 216). Nothing in it is a real procedure.

questions.prompt: tilda: (at the window, arms folded) Page one. NO-NONSENSE TILDA. First Mate. Write it down, clerk.

reply: tilda: (curt) Correct.
tilda[furious]: I am a FIRST MATE who is currently cardboard. Write the rank first.
tilda[smug]: ...Tempting. No. Write it properly. Stinkbeard's watching.

questions.prompt: ledger: (reading over your shoulder) Page three: APPLICANT'S COMPOSITION. Oh, I like this one.

reply: tilda: (looking down at herself) ...Both sides. There's Cheap-O-Rama on the back.
ledger: I'll put 'mostly fume, partly cardboard, wholly first mate'.
tilda[annoyed]: Clerk. Look at me. LOOK at me.

questions.prompt: documentary_narrator: (the form, in small print) PAGE FOUR. IS THE APPLICANT FLAMMABLE?

reply: tilda[stern]: (through her teeth) ...Yes.
ledger: I'll draw a little flame. For emphasis.
tilda: (quietly) Write yes, Stinkbeard. I'm not a liar. I'm just determined.

questions.prompt: tilda: Page nine: PREVIOUS IGNITION INCIDENTS. (a pause) There was a hat.

reply: tilda: Brogath's. Seventeen-thirty-something. He said it was a candle. It was a hat.
tilda[annoyed]: Two. It was TWO hats. Write two.
brogath: (from the lounge, helpfully) There was a hat!

lines: Pages ten to twenty-nine: WIND DIRECTION, ANCESTRY, OPINIONS ON CANDLES. Tilda has an opinion on every candle that has ever been lit.

questions.prompt: documentary_narrator: PAGE THIRTY. EYEBROW STATUS (FOR INSURANCE PURPOSES).

reply: brogath: (from the lounge, proudly) I did those. It took all afternoon.
tilda: Drawn on. By hand. With CARE.
tilda[stern]: (touching them) They are NOT at risk.

questions.prompt: tilda: Page thirty-one. PREFERRED GRAND STENCHMASTER. (before you can write anything) BROGATH THE BASHFUL.

reply: brogath: (from the lounge, a creak of pure joy) Me? She asked for ME?
You write it. Your hand is shaking a bit. Not from joy.
garrick: (from somewhere, delighted) Did somebody say a ceremonial engagement?
tilda[furious]: BROGATH. I have waited four hundred years. BROGATH.
tilda[annoyed]: Page thirty-one has no box for 'a lighter'. I checked.

questions.prompt: documentary_narrator: PAGE THIRTY-THREE. REQUESTED FLAME INTENSITY.

reply: tilda: Small. Ceremonial. Like the old days.

options.text: VERY SMALL. TINY. A RUMOUR OF A FLAME.
reply: tilda: (grudgingly) ...Fine.
You cross it out before the ink dries. Tilda watches you do it and says nothing, which is worse.

questions.prompt: documentary_narrator: PAGE FORTY. RECENT BEAN CONSUMPTION (APPLICANT AND PROVIDER).

reply: ledger: And the provider?
brogath: (very quietly) ...Some.
brogath: (very quietly, from the lounge) ...A bowl.

lines: Pages forty-one to fifty-nine: PRIOR SCORCH MARKS (none yet, Tilda says, in a voice that dares the future), SASH-HOLDING REQUIREMENTS (two holders, opposite sides), STRUCTURAL SAFETY (she's a cut-out, Ledger writes; 'MOSTLY UPRIGHT').

questions.prompt: documentary_narrator: PAGE SIXTY. DOES THE APPLICANT HAVE LUNGS?

reply: tilda: (a long pause) ...No.
captain: So how are you going to SMOKE it?
tilda[soft]: (quietly) That isn't the point, Stinkbeard. Fill in the form.
tilda[annoyed]: Don't flatter me. Write no.
ledger: I'll put UNKNOWN in the MAYBE column.

again: The box is very small. It wants a very small answer.

options.text: AGNES THE SECOND. OPERATIONALLY IMPORTANT. DO NOT TOAST.
reply: You write it the same way as last time. You write it bigger.
agnes_second: (from the lounge) Bawk.
You write it properly.
pete: (from the lounge, raising his bucket) Pete.
tilda: Running is not a procedure. Write 'proceed briskly'.

options.text: (Tilda signs. Then she makes YOU sign. Then Brogath.)
reply: Three signatures: a hard straight one, yours, and a very small bashful one with a crown drawn next to it.

done: The Bureau's stamp comes down: APPROVED. SUBJECT TO SAFETY CONDITIONS AGREED WITH THE CAPTAIN. She takes the permit off the counter and holds it like a letter from home.
